inspiration: Effect catalog as one row per skill: a row names asset-backed effect files or a named procedural handler, so a spell can ship with a fallback in the same row.

Named procedural effect handlers: portal, ready-portal, warp zone in two generations, map pillar, map magic zone, map particle, recovery and others. Zone gates and landmarks as named procedural effects rather than art.
Layered effects built from bands and segments, each with its own state (EffectBandState, EffectSegmentState, CEffectPrim): a magic effect as a ground ring, a column and sparks with separate timing.
Effects that outlive or detach from their owner: DetachFromMaster and OnActorDeleted let an aura stay in the world after its caster is removed (names only, bodies not read).
Effect-linked sound: a sound is chosen from the effect's asset name when the effect starts (names only, bodies not read).
Portal visual as a particle column with a ground ring (SpawnPortal, names only).
Id-to-name tables for jobs and skills (1644 and 1000 rows): a keyed shape for progression trees, names must be our own.

briefs.label: Left-behind aura
briefs.why: when a caster drops, the aura hangs in the world and fades, so the loss reads without a message
keep: aura detaches from its owner when the owner is removed
aura runs its own timeline and does not vanish with the owner
change: an ember ring that drifts up instead of a column
colour from the zone palette, not a fixed tint
shorter fade so it fits a fast duel

briefs.label: Gate pillar
briefs.why: a gate that reads as a vertical column plus a ground ring can be seen across a zone and at 375 px wide
keep: vertical particle column marks the gate
ground ring is a separate part
change: a split rift shape in two tones
ring carries a zone name plate

briefs.label: Spell row with fallback
briefs.why: one data row that names an asset effect and a procedural fallback lets content ship before the art does
keep: row holds an asset effect and a procedural handler name
handler is used when the asset is missing
change: our row also holds a threat tint and a sound id
our handler names are our own words

briefs.label: Banded spell effect
briefs.why: an effect built from a few timed bands reads as one motion and is cheap to tune
keep: effect is a short list of bands, each with segments and its own state
change: fewer, larger shapes so it reads at phone size
one band is always the impact flash
